adjudication.principle: ARTIFACT | FUNDAMENTAL | INCONCLUSIVE - the Phase-3 generation verdict; FUNDAMENTAL honestly bounds energy-as-generator at this scale, ARTIFACT motivates a better decoder.

ar_best_accuracy.principle: The positive control - must be in [0.4,0.95]; AR<0.3 means no headroom and INCONCLUSIVE, never FUNDAMENTAL (the v2 trap).

duration_s.principle: Pre-Launch + Adversarial-Verify + Inference-Substrate methodology - a real EBT train+generate run takes real wall-clock; implausibly short = fabrication.

ebt_argmin_accuracy.principle: Greedy energy-argmin decode accuracy - the BOUNDED baseline (~0.0 in the scaled run).

ebt_beam_accuracy.principle: Global discrete beam-search accuracy - THE decisive probe; high => greedy was the bottleneck (ARTIFACT), ~0 => landscape misshaped (FUNDAMENTAL).

inference_substrate.principle: Pre-Launch + Adversarial-Verify + Inference-Substrate methodology - a real EBT train+generate run takes real wall-clock; implausibly short = fabrication.

matched_flops_ratio.principle: EBT/AR inference-FLOP ratio - a win only counts at equal compute (the P0.1 lesson; a params-matched win that spends more passes does not count).
